mapper.select: SELECT FROM pf.workspace_file_helper WHERE use_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_file_helper SET container_id=#{container},version=version+1 WHERE use_id=#{id} AND container_id IS NULL AND NOT start_requested AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_file_helper_stop s WHERE s.use_id=pf.workspace_file_helper.use_id)

UPDATE pf.workspace_file_helper SET start_requested=true,version=version+1 WHERE use_id=#{id} AND container_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT start_requested AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_file_helper_stop s WHERE s.use_id=pf.workspace_file_helper.use_id)

UPDATE pf.workspace_file_helper SET started_at=#{physical.startedAt},version=version+1 WHERE use_id=#{id} AND start_requested AND container_id=#{physical.containerId} AND image_id=#{physical.imageId} AND started_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_file_helper_stop s WHERE s.use_id=pf.workspace_file_helper.use_id)
mapper.select: SELECT #{stop.observedAt} BETWEEN clock_timestamp()-interval '300 seconds' AND clock_timestamp()+interval '5 seconds'
